name: LLMs_Bench_on_Math
description: A benchmark assessing LLM performance on a variety of mathematical problems spanning arithmetic, algebra, and symbolic reasoning. It contains both multiple-choice and free-response problems designed to probe calculation, stepwise reasoning, and solution correctness. Used to evaluate models' math-solving and chain-of-thought capabilities.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted benchmark for math capabilities with modest community adoption for comparative evaluations.
